note: This data reflects laws as written, not how they are enforced. It covers the laws that apply to a woman living in the country’s main business city, so laws elsewhere in the country may differ. Where different groups of women follow different religious or family laws, it covers the largest group.
title: Can women get a job in the same way as men?
subtitle: “Yes” means a husband can’t stop his wife from working, and women don’t need any permission or documents to get a job that men don’t need.
